name: CREATE
description: Defines a new database object such as a table, view, or index.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(50));

name: ALTER
description: Modifies an existing database object.
codeExample: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email VARCHAR(255);

name: DROP
description: Deletes a database object.

name: TRUNCATE
description: Removes all rows from a table quickly.

name: SELECT
description: Retrieves data from one or more tables.

name: INSERT
description: Adds new rows to a table.

name: UPDATE
description: Modifies existing rows in a table.
codeExample: UPDATE users SET active = TRUE WHERE id = 1;

name: DELETE
description: Removes rows from a table.

name: WHERE
description: Filters rows based on a condition.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = TRUE;

name: GROUP BY
description: Groups rows for aggregate calculations.
codeExample: SELECT active, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY active;

name: HAVING
description: Filters groups created by GROUP BY.
codeExample: SELECT active, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY active HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

name: ORDER BY
description: Sorts query results.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY name ASC;

name: LIMIT
description: Restricts the number of returned rows.

name: JOIN
description: Combines rows from multiple tables.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id;

name: CASE
description: Conditional logic inside queries.
codeExample: SELECT CASE WHEN active THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM users;

name: BEGIN
description: Starts a transaction.

name: COMMIT
description: Saves all changes in a transaction.

name: ROLLBACK
description: Reverts all changes in a transaction.

name: GRANT
description: Gives permissions to a user or role.
codeExample: GRANT SELECT ON users TO analyst;

name: REVOKE
description: Removes permissions from a user or role.
codeExample: REVOKE SELECT ON users FROM analyst;

name: UPPER
description: Converts a string to uppercase.

name: LOWER
description: Converts a string to lowercase.

name: SUBSTRING
description: Extracts part of a string.
codeExample: SELECT SUBSTRING(name FROM 1 FOR 3) FROM users;

name: TRIM
description: Removes leading or trailing whitespace.

description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

name: ROW_NUMBER
description: Assigns a sequential number to rows in a window.
codeExample: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) FROM users;

name: RANK
description: Assigns ranking with gaps for ties.
codeExample: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) FROM results;

name: DENSE_RANK
description: Assigns ranking without gaps for ties.
codeExample: SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) FROM results;

name: LEAD
description: Returns the next row's value in a window.
codeExample: SELECT LEAD(score) OVER (ORDER BY id) FROM results;

name: LAG
description: Returns the previous row's value in a window.
codeExample: SELECT LAG(score) OVER (ORDER BY id) FROM results;
